summary.text: Sandra Loomis is the Democratic candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 30, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is retired from a career in aviation business management.

paragraphs.text: Sandra Loomis graduated from Susitna Valley High School and earned an associate degree from the University of Alaska Fairbanks in 1989.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Alaska for 58 years and had a career in aviation business management, and that she and her husband built an off-grid house powered mostly by solar energy.

In the same survey, Loomis said she is running on energy development, ethics in government and education funding, and she named the Permanent Fund Dividend and a balanced budget among her policy interests.
She advanced from the August 18, 2026 primary.
